verdict.rationale: Linear documents automatic intake of customer feedback. Asks from shared Slack channels can be auto-associated with customers, the Front and Intercom integrations cover support tools, and the marketing page claims conversations and feedback are automatically turned into routed issues. Nothing in the evidence covers capturing feedback from sales calls, and the support-ticket capture mechanics are only implied through integration mentions. missing for 10: sales-call capture (e.g., call-recording integration), detailed docs on automatic extraction from support tickets, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically capture customer feedback mentioned in sales calls, support tickets, and chat conversations

citations.quote: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
To automatically associate Asks from a shared Slack channel with a customer, open the customer page and choose **Link to Slack channel** from the **…** menu.
The Front integration now allows multiple labels from multi-select label groups
Customer attributes such as size and revenue can be synced with and managed from Intercom.
